rules.title: Jersey City RealPage ban / rent-setting algorithm ban
rules.quote: The Jersey City Council unanimously approved (9-0) a measure banning rent-setting algorithms such as RealPage, as well as increasing benefits for laborers, at last night's meeting.
rules.summary: Jersey City prohibits the use of rent-setting algorithms such as RealPage.
rules.effective_date_evidence: The Jersey City Council unanimously approved (9-0) a measure banning rent-setting algorithms such as RealPage, as well as increasing benefits for laborers, at last night's meeting. By Daniel Ulloa/Hudson County View … May 22, 2025 10:14 am
rules.coverage_text: The ordinance bans the use of certain nonpublic data in revenue management software; real estate agents and Multiple Listing Services for homes for sale are excluded.
rules.exemption_note: Real estate agents and Multiple Listing Services for homes for sale are excluded from the ordinance.
